lines.t: Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Cut ties, no lie, blade sharp on the spine of the timeline, yeah
I sever that bone
Whole clique full of snakes in the grass
Bare feet on the path like a field
Every inch in the ground
They smile but they whisper my name
Call it coke, call it phase
Call it anything to keep me in a cage
But the flame in my bones too heavy for the shade
When the line starts to roar, every wall gotta fade
She said I won't cut nobody off
That's a choice, not a flaw
That's a line in the dust, that's a side in the war
I ain't bending what I bleed for, die for, ride for
Word like a two-edged sword in my core
Girlfriend, baby, mama put a ring on her fingers
Cause she chose with the scarves at the door
So I step back, spine straight, heart sore
Peace in my face, feet clean from the floor
I don't break, I divide, line drawn in the sky
Pick a side, it's a war, not a lie
If you ride with the haters and the mockers
Or the boys understand you already chose your side
I stand with y'all, hands up high
No cap, every chain on my flesh get fried
If you war with this world, you war with my king
That means you can't walk by my side
Whole fam throwin' shade from the porch
They offended by the torch that I carry in the night
They'd rather keep peace with the dark
Than be scorched by the arc when it crashes through the pride
They say blood that's thicker than the water
But I'm bathed in a river that was red for my life
If the cross drew a line through the middle of my house
Then I'd follow that line with the knife
I ain't movin' out of fear, I'm just movin' out of trust
When he said step, I don't argue with the dust
Every rebel in my circle wanna cuddle with the rust
They can't have their applause, I'ma stay with the just
They mock every letter, every trumpet, every call
But the ink already branded in my chest
You can laugh at the message, but the stone still falls
And the rock still stands when it hits every crest
I don't break, I divide, line drawn in the sky
Pick a side, it's a war, not a vibe
If you ride with the haters and the mockers of the voice
Understand you already chose your side
I stand where y'all whoosh, you are hands up high
No cap, every chain on my flesh get fried
If you war with his word, you war with my king
That means you can't walk by my side
She say I'm just a guy, I'm a friend
I'm a stranger with a pen, but she knows who be speaking through the fire
She rather calm my nerves, keep the cousin undisturbed
Than respect what was breathed from the choir
They can eat with the scarf, trade memes, throw talk
Dressed out up nice in a gown
I'm a watchman on the wall with a sword and a jaw
That was forged to resound
not drown if you fight on his name you ain't cuddling with me i'm not sharing one pillow
with this smoke you can kiss me good night with a tear on your screen but the bond already broke
cause if you touch what he's in you just touched my blood and i'm loyal to the throne over flesh
i still pray for your soul i still beg for your breath but i won't let your rebellion in my nest
no hate in my veins no venom in my speech just a firewall lit by the king
I cut off hands that keep draggin' to the pit But I still keep the names when I sing
On my knees for the enemies, tears for the frenemies
Family or not, they can't share this ring If you curse what he's speakin' for a season
Your ex, you ain't worthy of the bling, or the bling
I don't break, I divide, line drawn in the sky
Pick a side, just a war, not a vibe If you ride with the haters and the mockers
of the boys, understand you already chose your side
I stand with Yahushua, hands up high, no cap, every chain on my flesh get fried
If you war with this world, you war with my king, that means you can't walk by my side
So I walk out the house with a book on my tongue, while the scoffers all scroll through stones from their phones
Every rebel I release from my couch, from my bed, from my table, from my throne
I ain't casting you to hell, I'm just handing you to him, I'm removing your grip from my dome
I chose king over king, over wife, over friends
Cause the lamb is my blood, that's the truth
